name: Real Estate
tagline: Draft property listings, prepare lead follow-ups, and update connected records with your approval.

useCases.title: Listing copy
useCases.description: Turn square footage, features, and neighborhood notes into a listing description and social captions.

useCases.title: Lead follow-up
useCases.description: Draft a reply to each new inquiry and log it to the CRM.

useCases.title: Comparative market analysis
useCases.description: Pull recent comparable sales, organize price-per-square-foot and days-on-market into a table, and draft a pricing rationale.

useCases.title: Showing coordination
useCases.description: Read a buyer's availability, propose showing slots, and create calendar invites once the seller confirms.

useCases.title: Document prep
useCases.description: Draft offer summaries, disclosure checklists, and closing timelines from your standard templates for your review.

useCases.title: Buyer matching
useCases.description: Give an agent your active listings and a buyer's criteria so it finds the best fits, with reasons.

faq.q: Can Ryu connect to my CRM and listing tools?
faq.a: Yes, if the tool has a supported app connection or MCP server. What an agent can do depends on that tool and your account's access, so test the workflow before it updates records or sends messages.

faq.q: Will it send emails to clients without my say-so?
faq.a: Not by default. Sending is a risky action, so it waits for your approval unless you change that rule. Workflow history and the Gateway's records of routed model calls show what ran, but not every action.

faq.q: Is my buyer and seller data kept private?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, client details stay on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.
